versions.content: If the DataPrototype is associated to an Array Implemen- tation Data Type the RTE API shall return an array expression (that is a pointer to the array base type) pointing to variable holding the value of the DataPrototype for which the API provides access. If the leaf ImplementationDataTypeElement is typed by a SwBaseType the array type name shall be equal to the nativeDecla- ration attribute of the SwBaseType . If the leaf ImplementationDataTypeEle- ment is typed by an ImplementationDataType the type name shall be equal to the shortName of these ImplementationDataType .
